headline: Apartment Rental Prices in August (Infographic) — Finance.ua
summary: Demand for apartment rentals in Ukraine grew in August 2026, according to Finance.ua. The report is an infographic on rental prices, and the full figures were not included in the input.
why: Rental prices reflect housing demand and household incomes, which matter for property investors and the wider consumer economy. Changes in rental markets can signal shifts in urban economic activity.
